Name: Rebekah's Greenhouse
Author: RebekahArt
Description:
Hi again! I'm back!

This time I come with a greenhouse edit. Again I tried to make it more cozier and a bit smaller than the original one. You have a spot to plant one of each 8 fruit trees and fixed the tiled soil to make if fit better the sprinkles, with a middle empy row so you can add a path. 

I left a hidden path, where you can go through the wall, so that you could walk around the outside of the map and cut down the trees, in case you have some already grown. So yes, this is intentional. You have to walk through the barrel under the bird at the top left.


All the tilesets use in this and all my mods are my own, I made them myself, so please do not redistribute them or this mod.

I don't know how to code so the mod it's probably not perfect, if you have any tips I'd be more than thankful, since I want to do more mods but I'm finding some issues that I don't know how to solve.



Check my Farm Cave mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39768]here[/url] or my Tiny Island Hut [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40402]here[/url]!


I'll be posting news and content on my site, so if you are interested you can check it out [url=https://rebekahart.weebly.com/]here[/url].

If you would like to donate, it would be more than welcome and I would deeply appreciate it, you can do so [url=https://ko-fi.com/rebekahart]here[/url].

Hope you like my mod, and thank you for downloading it.



Love, R.
